Here you can find some information about the bpb in English and some of our projects and upcoming events. The Federal Agency for Civic Education The work done by the Federal Agency for Civic Education (Bundeszentrale für politische Bildung/bpb) centres on promoting awareness for democracy and participation in politics. 05.03.2021 /
